Initial release of the web-capture skill.

- Captures your company’s website, competitor pages, and relevant news weekly, writing raw web reads and insights to your context repository in an append-only manner.
- First run seeds company and competitor positioning, offerings, inferred ICP, competitors/clients, and proof; later runs add weekly-dated change notes without editing prior files.
- Opens a GitHub pull request per run for human review and merge; never writes directly to the workspace context or modifies existing records.
- Skips workflows covered by monitor-buying-signals, research-account, or win-loss-review to avoid overlap.
- Requires modern Cargo AI CLI and CDK, an authenticated Anthropic connector, authorized GitHub access, and a properly structured GTM repository.
- Designed to keep GTM context fresh and consistent without manual effort.
